To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed a new chiral uranylsalen complex, which is an effective catalyst for the C H bond activation and functionalization of dialkylnilines under visible irradiation in the presence of H2O2 and NaCN.

a new uranyl(VI)salen complex is reported, which is a potential visible light activated catalyst for the functionalization of C H bonds of anilines to afford the corresponding a aminobenzonitriles in the presence of H2O2 and NaCN.
a new chiral uranylsalen complex is reported and its catalytic activity for visible light mediated cyanation of C H bonds of aniline derivatives has been demonstrated.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of a new chiral uranylsalen complex and the study of its potential as visible light active catalyst in the activation of C H bond of dialkylaniline.
the development of a new uranyl(VI)-based chiral catalyst for C H functionalization of dialykaniline under visible light.
the design and synthesis of new uranyl(VI)salen complex and its catalytic activity for C H bond amination of dialkylaniline derivatives under visible light.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
uranyl(VI)salen complexes are efficient and selective catalysts for C H bond amination of various substituted dialkylanilenes under visible light.
uranyl complex is a visible light active catalyst that can be used as a green alternative for the synthesis of aminonitrile.
the uranyl complex is a potential visible light active photocatalyst for the C H bond activation and functionalization of dialkanilines.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the chiral uranyl complex is a highly effective catalyst for C N bond formation under visible light.

the uranyl(VI)salen complex is an efficient and recyclable catalyst for visible light induced C H bond activation and functionalization of dialkanilanilines to aminonitrile derivatives under mild reaction conditions.
a chiral uranyl complex is found to be effective visible light active catalyst, and can be used for the synthesis of a aminonitrites under visible light.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the uranyl(VI)-salen complex is an efficient visible light activated catalyst for cyanation of C H bond of a wide range of dialkylaniline substrates, which is a rare example of visible light activated uranyl(VI)salen catalyst for cyanation.
the chiral uranyl complex was able to catalyze the C H bond activation under visible light.
the uranyl complex is highly active for C H bond cleavage and the catalysis is not limited to only aromatic C H bonds.
